392	//  HBM bf16 ACTS buffer (Fork B). Carved from the FRONT of the workspace the
393	//  host already allocates (float[nCTA*total + nCTA]); Fork B does not use that
394	//  space for the eliminated 223 MB grad partials, so it is free real estate.
395	//  Reinterpreted as __nv_bfloat16. Total 80,546,592 bf16 (161 MB) << the 223 MB
396	//  workspace; 62 MB headroom. All regions row-major [rows x width].
397	//
398	//  Offsets are RUNTIME (depend on T = B*kSeq, B is a host arg), computed by
399	//  DecActs::bind. The struct holds base pointers per region.
400	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
401	struct DecActs {
402	    // Per-layer linear INPUTS X (needed by dW = dY^T @ X):
403	    __nv_bfloat16* X_in[dec::kLayers];    // [T, d]    in_proj input (= layer input)
404	    __nv_bfloat16* X_ctx[dec::kLayers];   // [T, d]    out_proj input (attn context)
405	    __nv_bfloat16* X_x1[dec::kLayers];    // [T, d]    ff0 input (n1 output)
406	    __nv_bfloat16* X_gact[dec::kLayers];  // [T, dff]  ff2 input (gelu output)
407	    // Per-layer linear OUTPUT adjoints dY (needed by dW + bias db = Σ_t dY):
408	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_qkv[dec::kLayers];  // [T, 3d]   in_proj output adjoint
409	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_a[dec::kLayers];    // [T, d]    out_proj output adjoint
410	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_ff0[dec::kLayers];  // [T, dff]  ff0 output adjoint
411	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_ff2[dec::kLayers];  // [T, d]    ff2 output adjoint
412	    // Head (B rows — last position only):
413	    __nv_bfloat16* X_hn;                  // [B, d]    head input
414	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_logits;             // [B, V]    head output adjoint (dlogits)
415	    // Embedding-input adjoint (needed by tok/pos owner-scan):
416	    __nv_bfloat16* dh0;                   // [T, d]
417	};

419	__device__ __forceinline__ DecActs dec_acts_bind(__nv_bfloat16* p, int T, int B) {
420	    DecActs a;
421	    int64_t off = 0;
422	    const int64_t Td = (int64_t)T * dec::kD;
423	    const int64_t T3d = (int64_t)T * 3 * dec::kD;
424	    const int64_t Tff = (int64_t)T * dec::kDff;
425	    for (int li = 0; li < dec::kLayers; ++li) {
426	        a.X_in[li]   = p + off; off += Td;
427	        a.X_ctx[li]  = p + off; off += Td;
428	        a.X_x1[li]   = p + off; off += Td;
429	        a.X_gact[li] = p + off; off += Tff;
430	        a.dY_qkv[li] = p + off; off += T3d;
431	        a.dY_a[li]   = p + off; off += Td;
432	        a.dY_ff0[li] = p + off; off += Tff;
433	        a.dY_ff2[li] = p + off; off += Td;
434	    }
435	    a.X_hn      = p + off; off += (int64_t)B * dec::kD;
436	    a.dY_logits = p + off; off += (int64_t)B * dec::kVocab;
437	    a.dh0       = p + off; off += Td;
438	    return a;
439	}

441	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
442	//  bf16 WEIGHT PRE-STAGE (reg-pressure campaign C1 + cp.async-ring blocker (a)).
443	//  The fwd/dX GEMMs' B operand was the fp32 params blob CONVERTED ON READ
444	//  (__float2bfloat16 inside the staging accessor). That conversion web is the
445	//  measured marginal register demand of the K-loop (the pure-bf16 dW path
446	//  allocates spill-free at the same accumulator width while the fp32-read
447	//  fwd/dX paths spill ~2.2 KB when isolated), and it is the documented blocker
448	//  (a) of the cp.async/TMA ring: an async copy cannot convert, so the dominant
449	//  operand could not stream. Fix: convert ONCE per step into a bf16 weight
450	//  cache carved from the workspace, and stage the GEMM B operand from the
451	//  cache. cache[i] = __float2bfloat16(params[i]) is the IDENTICAL deterministic
452	//  per-element rounding the on-read path performed -> every GEMM consumes
453	//  BIT-IDENTICAL operand values; numerics/parity/A-A-A are unchanged BY
454	//  CONSTRUCTION (pure caching of a pure function; no reorder, no reassociation).
455	//
456	//  Only the 8 per-layer GEMM weight matrices (in_w/out_w/ff0_w/ff2_w x layers)
457	//  are cached: they are the ONLY fp32->bf16 on-read GEMM operands (the head
458	//  runs scalar fp32 per the oracle; embeddings/biases/LN are scalar fp32; the
459	//  dW GEMM operands are bf16 acts already). All sizes derive from the layout
460	//  constants -- no problem-specific hardcoding; the bench layout scales it.
461	//
462	//  C1-T (RING): a SECOND section of the cache holds the same 8 matrices
463	//  TRANSPOSED (W^T [Kin,Nout]). The dX GEMM reads W transposed; from the
464	//  row-major cache that staging is a k-stride 2-byte gather, which no 4/8/16B
465	//  cp.async can express (the same structural shape as ring blocker (b)).
466	//  Staging dX's B operand from W^T instead makes its tile rows K-CONTIGUOUS,
467	//  so the cp.async double-buffered ring streams BOTH fwd and dX weight
468	//  operands. WT[r,c] == W-cache[c,r] bit-identically (same fp32 element, same
469	//  deterministic rounding, written by exactly one thread) -> operand values,
470	//  parity and A/A/A are unchanged by construction. Cost: the cache doubles
471	//  (1.57 MB at d=128, 101 MB at d=1024 -- workspace headroom verified at both).
472	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
473	struct DecWBf {
474	    const __nv_bfloat16* in_w[dec::kLayers];    // [3d, d]  per layer
475	    const __nv_bfloat16* out_w[dec::kLayers];   // [d, d]   per layer
476	    const __nv_bfloat16* ff0_w[dec::kLayers];   // [dff, d] per layer
477	    const __nv_bfloat16* ff2_w[dec::kLayers];   // [d, dff] per layer
478	    // ── C1-T (RING section): the SAME four matrices stored TRANSPOSED, W^T
479	    //    [Kin, Nout] row-major. WT[r,c] == W-cache[c,r] BIT-IDENTICAL (the same
480	    //    __float2bfloat16 of the same fp32 element, stored twice). Purpose: the
481	    //    dX GEMM's B operand reads W TRANSPOSED (srcB(n=kin,k=out) = W[out,kin],
482	    //    a k-stride-Kin 2-byte gather the cp.async ring cannot stream — the same
483	    //    structural shape as ring blocker (b)). Staging from W^T instead makes
484	    //    the dX B-tile rows K-CONTIGUOUS (16B-chunkable), unblocking the ring on
485	    //    the dX path with UNCHANGED operand values → numerics/parity/A-A-A
486	    //    identical by construction. ──
487	    const __nv_bfloat16* in_wT[dec::kLayers];   // [d, 3d]  per layer
488	    const __nv_bfloat16* out_wT[dec::kLayers];  // [d, d]   per layer
489	    const __nv_bfloat16* ff0_wT[dec::kLayers];  // [d, dff] per layer
490	    const __nv_bfloat16* ff2_wT[dec::kLayers];  // [dff, d] per layer
491	};
492	constexpr int64_t kWbfInW        = (int64_t)3 * dec::kD * dec::kD;
493	constexpr int64_t kWbfOutW       = (int64_t)dec::kD * dec::kD;
494	constexpr int64_t kWbfFf0W       = (int64_t)dec::kDff * dec::kD;
495	constexpr int64_t kWbfFf2W       = (int64_t)dec::kD * dec::kDff;
496	constexpr int64_t kWbfLayerElems = kWbfInW + kWbfOutW + kWbfFf0W + kWbfFf2W;
497	constexpr int64_t kWbfTotalElems = (int64_t)dec::kLayers * kWbfLayerElems;
498	// Full cache: straight section [kWbfTotalElems] + transposed section (C1-T,
499	// same element count — every matrix size is a multiple of 8 so both sections
500	// and every per-matrix base stay 16B-aligned for the cp.async ring).
501	constexpr int64_t kWbfCacheElems = 2 * kWbfTotalElems;
502	// Workspace floats the cache occupies (bf16 elems -> float units, rounded up).
503	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t dec_wbf_floats() {
504	    return (kWbfCacheElems + 1) / 2;
505	}
506	__device__ __forceinline__ DecWBf dec_wbf_bind(const __nv_bfloat16* c) {
507	    DecWBf wb;
508	    #pragma unroll
509	    for (int li = 0; li < dec::kLayers; ++li) {
510	        const __nv_bfloat16* b = c + (int64_t)li * kWbfLayerElems;
511	        wb.in_w[li]  = b;
512	        wb.out_w[li] = b + kWbfInW;
